_comment: shotlist.json — what the H3 Shot List Loader reads. One entry per shot. Emitted by h3plan.py, or hand-authored. Paths are relative to project_root.
prompt_prefix: The target video is a 2D hand-drawn cartoon animation with flat 2D illustration, clean black line art, flat solid colors, and cel-shaded artwork. <Picture 4> defines the series art style: line weight, color palette, and shading treatment.

cast._comment: sheet = horizontal 4-panel strip: 3/4 body, side, back, face close-up. Authored at 4096x1024 or larger so `max` mode keeps each panel sharp.

shots._comment: Establishing shot, nobody speaks. H3 generates the whole soundscape and it goes straight into the mp4.
prompt: subject_definitions:

<Subject 1> is Huey, defined by <Picture 1> — a character model sheet showing the SAME single character in four views (three-quarter body, side, back, and facial close-up). It is one character, not four.
summary:
[reference generation] <Subject 1> stands at the edge of a yard watching an empty suburban street in late afternoon light.
retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - facial identity, hairstyle, proportions, wardrobe and colors are retained from <Picture 1>.
detailed_description:

[Shot 1] A late-afternoon suburban street edge with a dense treeline beyond, warm low sun and long shadows. <Subject 1> stands small in frame near the edge of the yard, watching the empty street. The camera holds a static wide shot.
overall_soundscape: Late-afternoon suburban ambience with distant birdsong, a faint breeze moving through the treeline, and occasional distant traffic.
non_diegetic_music: N/A

shots._comment: Two-hander with dialogue. audio_in/out slice the master track — that slice drives lip-sync, and the mp4 is written mute so the clean vocal goes in at conform.
prompt: subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is Riley, defined by <Picture 1> — a model sheet of ONE character shown in a three-quarter body view and a facial close-up.
<Subject 2> is Huey, defined by <Picture 2> — a model sheet of ONE character shown in a three-quarter body view and a facial close-up.
<Audio 1> is the voice and timing reference for the spoken lines below.
summary:
[reference generation + audio reference] <Subject 1> runs in with news and <Subject 2> flatly refuses to believe him.
retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - identity, braids, hoodie and proportions retained from <Picture 1>.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - identity, afro, red shirt and proportions retained from <Picture 2>.
<Audio 1>: reference - its vocal delivery and phrasing guide the performance and mouth timing without copying the signal.
detailed_description:

[Shot 1] A late-afternoon suburban street edge with a dense treeline beyond. <Subject 1> runs into frame from the left and stops hard beside <Subject 2>, breathing fast. <Subject 2> does not turn his head. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed on the two of them.
<Subject 1> (S1) says, breathless and certain, <d>[English] There's gold at the end of the path.</d>
<Subject 2> (S2) says, flat and unmoved, <d>[English] There is not.</d>
overall_soundscape: Running footsteps arriving on dry grass, fabric movement, and continuing late-afternoon suburban ambience underneath.
non_diegetic_music: N/A

shots._comment: Close-up on one character — panel_mode auto spends the full 4-panel strip here, because identity is the whole point of the shot. Cloned voice: no recording needed, H3 speaks the line in the sampled timbre.
prompt: subject_definitions:

<Subject 1> is Riley, defined by <Picture 1> — a character model sheet showing the SAME single character in four views (three-quarter body, side, back, and facial close-up). It is one character, not four.
<Audio 1> is the voice-timbre reference for <Subject 1> (S1).
summary:
[reference generation + audio reference] A closer framing on <Subject 1> as he fixes on the woods and backs away.
retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - facial identity, braids and hoodie retained from <Picture 1>.
<Audio 1>: reference - the target voice follows its timbre and delivery without copying the original signal.
detailed_description:

[Shot 1] A closer framing on <Subject 1>'s face and shoulders, the treeline soft and out of focus behind him in warm late-afternoon light. His eyes fix on the woods and he starts to back away toward the house. The camera holds a static shot as he exits frame right.
<Subject 1> (S1) says, already turning away, <d>[English] I've got to pack.</d>
overall_soundscape: Sneakers scuffing dry grass over steady outdoor ambience with distant birds.
non_diegetic_music: N/A
